function processTickets(tickets) {
    // Filter out tickets below 23
    const filteredTickets = tickets.filter(ticket => ticket >= 23);
    
    // Add the filtered tickets to a new array

    // Split the combined tickets into 7 equal parts

    const parts = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < combinedTickets.length; i += partSize) {

    }
